name: Vedansh Saini
description: Vedansh Saini is a backend and systems engineer and open source contributor studying at IIT (BHU) Varanasi, and an incoming SDE intern at Amazon (Summer 2027). He is a two-time Google Summer of Code contributor at FOSSASIA. In 2025 he built Scrum Helper, which he presented at FOSSASIA Summit 2026, and in 2026 he has been working on Visdom Cloud, which adds multi-tenancy to the open-source Visdom visualization tool. He has been a mentee under CNCF KubeStellar and has contributed to the AI Alliance's gofannon project and Apache Mahout. He also serves as a Tech Team Representative at IIT (BHU). His interests are distributed systems, developer tooling, and AI infrastructure.
